newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates steady in selective trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates steady in selective trade.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates held steady on Sunday as spinners bought selectively amid reports that ginners were holding back large stocks to create an artificial shortage, dealers said.
They said prices were likely to fall as selling pressure would soon force ginners to bring their stocks to market.
"More than one million (375-lb) bales are estimated to be lying at ginning factories unsold," one dealer said.
In the kerb market, NIAB-78 variety was traded at 2,350 rupees ($58.42) per maund (37.32 kg), dealers said.
